examples.description: Look at a generated scene's lighting before grading it

description: Look at a generated scene's actual frames (vision) and describe subject, lighting, composition, mood. Make editing decisions based on what you SEE, not assumptions. Refuses with SIMPLER_STUDIO_VISION_NONE while no model on this platform can look at video frames (nothing is sent or spent): judge the scene from its prompt and the composition instead.
